def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != 0]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)

    # The inner color is the color occupying the central area of the rectangle.
    counts = {}
    for r, c in points:
        counts[grid[r][c]] = counts.get(grid[r][c], 0) + 1
    frame = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    inner = next(color for color in counts if color != frame)

    core = [(r, c) for r, c in points if grid[r][c] == inner]
    core_h = max(r for r, c in core) - min(r for r, c in core) + 1
    core_w = max(c for r, c in core) - min(c for r, c in core) + 1
    pad = max(1, (max(core_h, core_w) + 1) // 2)

            if out[r][c] == 0:
